svg.title: “So I went on and on and on and wrote Efuru. I got it typed and thought it wasn’t a bad story, but I didn’t have the courage to give it to anybody, to read. Then I gave it to Chinua Achebe … And once your book is accepted for publication, you become a writer! … The first African woman to have a novel published by Heinemann of London … I made history!” — Flora Nwapa, interviewed for NRK television, Norway, 1987 As quoted in Paula Uimonen, Invoking Flora Nwapa: Nigerian Women Writers, Femininity and Spirituality in World Literature, 2020
